ValidationRule.description: Ensures the correct element lookup is populated based on the Related Element Type selection.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Related_Element_Type__c, 'Pile'), ISBLANK(Pile__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Related_Element_Type__c, 'Raft'), ISBLANK(Raft__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Related_Element_Type__c, 'Pedestal'), ISBLANK(Pedestal__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please populate the element lookup field matching the Related Element Type selected (Pile, Raft, or Pedestal).
